_note: Every rule is a DRAFT until a source is verified and status is set to approved. Drafts never fire. Severity: caution | warning | block.

rules.message: Solvent-based finishes release vapors. Use a respirator rated for organic vapors and ventilate. Match the cartridge to the product's safety data sheet.
Wood and MDF dust is a respiratory hazard. Dust collection plus a fitted respirator for sanding.
Confirm the rated working load limit of every sling, harness and hook exceeds the load. Inspect each one before use.
